categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and internal CI cache actions to run native macOS arm64 CI tests on cross-compiled binaries.
categories.rationale: Closes a major gap in CI platform testing by executing cross-built macOS binaries natively. As noted in the description, cross-compiled macOS binaries were previously unexecuted in CI, allowing platform-specific crashes like #35771 to reach release branches.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and introduces native runner execution for unit tests (`test_bitcoin` and `test_bitcoin-qt`) on macOS arm64.
categories.rationale: Expands unit test coverage to run release-like binaries on native macOS hardware. The description points to realistic runtime regressions such as Qt unit test segfaults (#35771) that otherwise go undetected by the test suite.
